events.title: Back into Canada on the Top of the World Highway, YT
events.thought: End of day fifty-six. Next stop -- Dawson City to the Dempster Highway.
events.photoCaption: Waldo on a Dempster ridgeline, vast fall-toned Yukon mountains stretching to every horizon under deep blue sky.

events.title: Waldo on Taylor Mountain
events.thought: A tiny black speck on the side of Taylor Mountain — Waldo and the Yukon on equal terms.
events.photoCaption: Waldo navigates the descent of Taylor Mountain across fall tundra in full color, the Yukon's infinite ridgelines receding behind.

events.title: Chicken, Alaska
events.thought: Chicken, Alaska — the rooster and the signpost say it all.
events.photoCaption: The famous metal rooster and directional signpost in Chicken, Alaska, pointing to chicken-named places worldwide.
